page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.3xlarge is a local-storage-equipped compute instance belonging to the ecs.i5ge family. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs sourced from an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz. Virtualization is handled via KVM, ensuring stable multi-tenant isolation and predictable execution times across dedicated CPU threads without resource oversubscription.

The instance is provisioned with 72.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 6.0 GB per vCPU allocation that sits between standard general-purpose and memory-heavy profiles. A critical hardware component is its 1919 GB of integrated local SSD storage, which delivers direct disk access without the network overhead typically associated with remote block volumes. For external communication and cluster synchronization, the instance provides a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

From an architectural standpoint, the bundling of 1.9 TB of local solid-state storage with balanced memory density presents distinct efficiency benefits for write-heavy and latency-sensitive deployments. Because there is no GPU accelerator attached, compute is strictly general x86_64 execution. The dedicated core allocation and low-latency storage profile make this configuration well fitted for mid-tier relational database systems, NoSQL datastores, real-time analytics nodes, and distributed messaging platforms requiring sustained disk write throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.3xlarge is a storage-focused instance designed for I/O-intensive workloads requiring consistent local disk throughput and dedicated CPU capability. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, the instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz across 12 dedicated vCPUs. System resources include 72.0 GB of RAM, offering 6.0 GB per core, along with an integrated 1919 GB local SSD. Network communication is supported by a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth profile, facilitating fast transfer rates for data synchronization. The combination of dedicated compute cores, generous memory density, and bundled high-speed local disk capacity delivers strong qualitative cost efficiency by eliminating dependency on external network-attached volumes for active state. Operating without hardware accelerators, the server is suitable for transactional databases, search indexing engines, distributed caching clusters, and low-latency log analytics.
